verdict.rationale: Plausible lets you send events from all three surfaces: a lightweight web script with SPA support, a WordPress plugin and a GTM template for the web, plus an HTTP Events API it explicitly recommends for Android/iOS apps and server-side tracking. The story's core requirement is official SDKs for major languages and platforms, and the evidence shows none, so mobile and backend developers would have to hand-roll HTTP calls. Missing for 10: official mobile SDKs (iOS/Android), official backend language SDKs (e.g. Node, Python, Go), and independent corroboration of the mobile/server ingestion workflow.
